text_block_list.text:
We get right back to our regular<n>training after
summer camp. As part<n>of that, we decide to hold a
scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So, who's my opponent for today?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hiii, Hayahide! Are you as excited to<n>race as I am?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you sure you want me to<n>race her? I
don't think revealing my<n>strategies right before the
Kikuka Sho<n>is a good idea.
choice_data_list:
I arranged this because I have a feeling you're not
ready.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying you know what's<n>missing from the
equation I've<n>poured myself into, then?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I get it. This race is meant to<n>help me with
that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'll get ready. And I'm not going tolose.

The race between Winning Ticket and<n>Biwa
Hayahide begins.

Things start getting interesting on the<n>straightaway,
right after the fourth<n>corner...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I've pulled quite far ahead of Ticket.<n>Her sprint
speed is worrisome, but<n>according to our data, I
should be fine<n>with this big of a lead.)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ngh! RAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Is... Is she charging forward already?<n>That's fast!
But that speed's not<n>sustainable. She'll be out of
stamina<n>in 200 meters!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I'm not going to let her reckless<n>gambit shake me
up, though. As long<n>as I maintain this pace and
sprint in<n>the final stretch...)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: RAAAGGGHHH!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I'm still in the lead. Stay calm. Just<n>300 meters to
go. I can maintain this<n>lead. And once she runs out
of<n>steam—)
choice_data_list: You need to go on the offensive, Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ngh, even if I wanted to—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hrrrngh... WAAAGH! I... WILL... WIN!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(No way... How... How are you next to<n>me? Now
you're in front?)

Winning Ticket overtakes Biwa<n>Hayahide and flies
across the finish<n>line.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze... How?! How could Ihave...
choice_data_list: Why didn't you go on offense?
Why didn't you go on offense?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew! That was a nice one! Wanna<n>go again? I
know how much it sucks<n>to lose!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But I like winning a lot too, so I won't<n>just give you
the victory!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I think that's enough, wild child.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Let her work at her own pace. If you<n>still have
energy left over, why don't<n>you go for a run with
me?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go! Later, Hayahide.

After she finishes her cooldown, I<n>hand Biwa
Hayahide a drink.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Remember how you told me I needed<n>to go on the
offensive during the<n>race?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I finally figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I didn't go on the<n>offensive. It's that I
was too busy<n>playing defense. That's the
difference between me and them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I was trying not to lose.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, I'm always<n>playing it safe.
They invariably say<n>they want to win, but I only
think<n>about not wanting to lose.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even the winning equation I've been<n>working on
since I was young...

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Wow! Brian is even faster than<n>Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Parent
text_block_list.text:
She really is! Brian's so amazing. She<n>might
outshine her older sister!

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Don't count... me out!I'm gonna get... so much faster! I'llbe.. the fastest anyone's ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'll be fast enough... to beat Brian one<n>day!
Crash!

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis?!

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I... I lost again... Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll win next time! I'll come up with an<n>equation to
win so I'll never lose to<n>anyone! Especially not
her...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The whole reason I started working<n>on my winning
equation was because<n>I didn't want to lose.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ironic, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's no wonder Ticket and Taishin<n>always exceed
the parameters of my<n>little calculations. Of course
they do.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: They're always on theoffensive—willing to do whatever ittakes for a chance at victory because they're trying to win.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Their way of thinking differs from<n>mine on a
fundamental level. There's<n>simply no way my
equation can<n>compete with them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How stupid of me to call it a "winning<n>equation"
when all I've been doing is<n>calculating how not to
lose!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why did it take me so long to figure it<n>out? What's
the point anymore?!
choice_data_list:
Mistakes are learning opportunities. You can fix it
now that you've realized what's wrong.

text_block_list.text:
If Biwa Hayahide was the type of<n>Umamusume to
throw away her<n>dreams over something like this...

Then she would have given up a long<n>time ago
when she got hurt trying to<n>catch up to her sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That might be true, but we'll have to<n>start over from
square one.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I established the equation on the<n>wrong basis, and
now I have to scrap<n>it and rebuild everything from
scratch.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's not much time until the<n>Kikuka Sho. If we
do this, it's going to<n>take up a lot of your time too.
choice_data_list: You want to win the Kikuka Sho, right?
You want to win the Kikuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: If so, I'm here to help.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You're... You're an idiot...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I'm an even bigger idiot, which is<n>why I'm
accepting your offer.

We resume training immediately to<n>reformulate her
winning equation.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah! Hayahide, you really came!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket? What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Taishin said you were sure to<n>show up if we
waited! Right, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Maybe you were waiting. I wasletting you take a break so we couldgo for a run.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin! You're such a meanie!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go for a run. Join us if you<n>want. Or
don't.
choice_data_list: Are you two here to cheer Hayahide up?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Yeah! We might be rivals, but<n>we're friends
first and foremost!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You know you can always talk to us if<n>you've got
something on your mind,<n>right, Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I do... It seems I've been too<n>narrow-minded. I'll
need to do<n>something about that.

Biwa Hayahide jogs toward the track<n>after her
friends.
